html:
Quest Giver: UndercoverPancakes975

Quest Type: Collect

Quest Description: Find UndercoverPancakes975 in Level 1 of MutantMania. Give him Okon's check in exchange for the action figure.

Quest Reward: Gold

Return to: UndercoverPancakes975

Repeatable: No

Following Quest: Okon's Inaction Figure, Part 2

Zone: Mutant Mania

In-game text

Journal text, offer, and turn-in as they appeared in game.

Journal: Find UndercoverPancakes975 in Level 1 of MutantMania. Give him Okon's check in exchange for the action figure.

Offer:

Thankth again for getting back my autographed picture of Menathing Manglefeet the Murderouth. It'th my fav'rite thing in the whole world. Thomeday, I'm going to be like Manglefeet. I'm going to be the championetht fighter of the whole world! Next to Manglefeet, I mean. No one can beat him!

You wanna know thomething? I collect autographth and pictureth and armor and weaponth and anything from MutantMania. Thometimes you have to pay for thethe thingth, but I don't mind. My papa gave me a lot of gold and King'th Cointh, so I can buy bunches of collectibleth.

Could you do me another favor? I bought a new action figure through ectoBay--I mean, I have the original verthion, but thith new one is thpecial because it'th got different colorth. AND, it'th thtill in the original box! I'm not allowed to leave, but if I gave you thith check, would you go find the theller on Level 1 and pick it up for me? Hith name is UndercoverPancaketh975.

Turn-in:

Hello! Me UndercoverPancakes975. You from Okon? He say have something for me? Money, yes?

Objectives:

  • Okon's Check ×1

Level range: 81–100
